description: Install and link Rig — the local runtime context engine for AI coding agents on your Mac — so Codex and ChatGPT can use Rig’s local MCP hub when Rig is running.

defaultPrompt: Help me install Rig on my Mac and link Codex to Rig’s local MCP hub.
I have Rig open — walk me through connecting ChatGPT developer mode to the local hub.
My Rig MCP tools aren’t showing — what should I check in Rig → Connections?
interface.longDescription: Rig is the local runtime context engine for AI coding agents on Mac. This plugin helps you install the Rig app and connect Codex or ChatGPT (developer mode) to Rig’s local MCP hub so agents can use your machine’s project status, logs, managed servers, and related tools while Rig is running. Live tools require Rig open locally and a linked hub — this listing does not provide a public cloud MCP.
